system.description:
Heart or Strange; 3 Soul or Corrosive; Long (150 ft). Terrifying: a target hit with Soul damage must pass a CR 2 Strange Check or become Afraid. Corrode: a target hit with Corrosive damage must pass a CR 1 Luck Check or be Weakened (CR -1) until the Combat Encounter ends.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.145
